query: convert text into a URL-safe slug
note: sanitize_tool_name (string_utils.py:26, not pooled) does a similar normalisation but is tool-name specific (fixed '_', 64-char truncation with hash suffix); judged not relevant.

query: compute the SHA-256 hash of a string
note: generate_doc_id(content=s) returns sha256(s) hex, so calling it satisfies the need (wrapper rule) - borderline. _AuthStore.compute_key hashes 'type:data' (not a plain string hash); file-hash helpers take files/chunks, not strings: not relevant.

query: split long text into overlapping chunks
note: Borderline: the seven identical *KnowledgeSource._chunk_text methods are private but do exactly overlapping fixed-size chunking (step = size - overlap), labelled relevant. chunk_text takes a TextFile (trivial wrap). RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter internals (_split_text, _merge_splits, _split_by_characters, no overlap) not relevant; the public split_text covers them.

query: extract the video id from a YouTube URL
parse JSON that contains comments and trailing commas
note: strip_jsonc_comments + json.loads is trivial adaptation. _load_jsonc (cli) parses a JSONC file (path input). load_jsonc_file added from outside the pool. _strip_jsonc_comments / _strip_trailing_commas each handle only half the need: not relevant. _safe_repair_json uses json_repair for agent tool input: not relevant.

query: keep outgoing calls under a fixed number per minute
note: Borderline: BraveSearchToolBase._rate_limit is a generic thread-safe min-interval throttle (requests per second; set rps=N/60), but a private method of a search tool - labelled relevant. enforce_rpm_limit only calls the callable it is given (wrapper that does not satisfy the need alone): not relevant. Nested _check_and_increment not relevant.

query: tell whether a network address points to an internal host
note: _is_local_collector / _encrypted check loopback/localhost only, not private ranges: not relevant. validate_url (safe_path.py:225, not pooled) resolves a URL and rejects private IPs, but is URL-fetch validation with scheme checks; judged not relevant (borderline).

query: guess what kind of file some raw bytes are
note: URLReadTool._sniff is a staticmethod identifying pdf/docx/xlsx/html/text from bytes: relevant. _fallback_content_type(None, data) sniffs bytes: relevant (borderline, private). FileBytes._detect_content_type is a model validator, _resolve_kind is tool dispatch: not relevant.

query: shrink a picture so it fits within a maximum size
note: Query is ambiguous between max dimensions and max file size: resize_image (dimensions, intended) and optimize_image (reduce quality to fit a byte budget) both labelled relevant. FileProcessor._auto_process_image is private orchestration needing processor constraints: not relevant.

query: convert a 1-based index into Excel-style letters like AA
note: _cell_index does the inverse (letters to index): not relevant.

query: fill in named placeholders in a template without breaking JSON braces
note: Borderline: render_template fills {{name}} placeholders in a template file (used for .jsonc templates) and leaves other braces alone; takes a Path, labelled relevant. Expression.render_template is CEL ${...} evaluation and Task/Crew interpolation methods are object-specific: not relevant.

query: recognise an error caused by the prompt being too long for the model
note: Intended public helper is_context_length_exceeded (agent_utils.py:997) was NOT in the pool; added outside the pool. is_context_window_overflowing_threshold is a proactive size check, not error recognition: not relevant.

query: pull a JSON object out of chatty model output
note: handle_partial_json, _fit_response_model, _validate_structured_output all extract JSON but require a pydantic model (and may call an LLM): not relevant. extract_a2ui_json_objects only keeps A2UI objects: not relevant. post_process_result only extracts when an output format is configured: not relevant.

query: make arbitrary Python objects safe to dump as JSON
note: to_string and handlers._serialize are json.dumps(to_serializable(x)) wrappers that satisfy the need. CrewJSONEncoder.default (not pooled) raises for unknown types, so not 'arbitrary': not relevant. _is_json_serializable only checks; _serialize_static_value is flow-definition specific: not relevant.

query: how long to wait before the next attempt after being throttled
note: Several functions compute a wait: Retry-After readers (_retry_delay, _retry_after, _retry_after_seconds) and backoff calculators (get_retry_delay_seconds, gemini _compute_backoff_delay; the latter is plain backoff, borderline). Retry loops (run_with_rate_limit_retry, MCP retry helpers) perform retries rather than return the delay: not relevant.

query: check a signed login token against the identity provider's public keys
note: OIDCAuth.authenticate verifies a JWT against the issuer's JWKS: relevant. OAuth2ServerAuth.authenticate does so when jwks_url is configured (else introspection): borderline relevant; its private _authenticate_jwt is covered by it. _validate_and_save_token is CLI login with side effects; verify_agent_card_signature verifies agent cards, not login tokens: not relevant.

query: turn strings like 7d or 24h into a time span
note: WaitTool._resolve_duration clamps numeric seconds, does not parse '7d': not relevant.

query: convert a markdown document to HTML
note: Verified unanswerable: no indexed function converts Markdown to HTML (MDX loader strips JSX to text; SerplyWebpageToMarkdownTool is the reverse direction).

query: send an email through an SMTP server
note: Verified unanswerable: no SMTP/email-sending function in indexed code (only 'gmail/send_email' as an example string for platform apps).

query: parse a cron expression and compute the next run time
note: Verified unanswerable: no cron parsing or scheduling code (no croniter/crontab usage).
